module_summary: AXI-Stream FIFO (64-bit, tkeep enabled): write logic packs beats into RAM via write/commit pointers; a read pipeline fetches via rd pointer to the output, with full/empty and depth status.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Main FIFO RAM holding packed tdata/tlast/tuser beats.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem, incremented on accepted input beats.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem, incremented when a beat enters the output pipeline.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer; frames become visible to reader once committed, used for empty.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload packed into s_axis and written to mem.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; with tready triggers writes into mem.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready derived from full and drop/mark mode parameters.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload from last RAM pipeline stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid driven from valid pipeline, optionally gated by pause.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing the output pipeline and read pointer.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pointer MSB compare; deasserts s_axis_tready and triggers drop/mark.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: Commit pointer equals read pointer; blocks read pointer increment.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Frame overflow flag (frame mode only) forcing drop or send of oversize frame.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Set while discarding the current frame; parameter-disabled in this config.

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Marks truncated frame bad via tlast/tuser override when full.

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Forces commit of oversize frame beats in frame mode.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks being inside an input frame for mark-when-full.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM read pipeline stages carrying beats from mem to the output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid chain for the read pipeline stages; bubbles allow advance.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: Ready into the read pipeline enabling stage transfers and reads.

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input word (data, tlast, tuser) written into mem.

anchors.name: m_axis
anchors.why: Packed output word from last pipeline stage unpacked into fields.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Input end-of-frame stored with beat and steering frame tracking.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame unpacked from stored beat.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input user sideband stored with beat, overridden on marked frames.

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Input byte-enable sideband packed with each beat into mem.

anchors.name: status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy output from registered write-read pointer difference.

anchors.name: status_depth_commit
anchors.why: Committed occupancy output from commit pointer minus read pointer.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped frame due to overflow.

anchors.name: status_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped bad frame.

anchors.name: status_good_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a committed good frame.

groups.name: Write controller
groups.description: Accepts input beats, writes mem, manages commit pointer and frame drop/mark logic.

groups.name: FIFO RAM
groups.description: Dual-pointer RAM storing packed stream beats.

groups.name: Read pipeline
groups.description: Reads mem through RAM pipeline registers and drives the output stream handshake.

groups.name: Status
groups.description: Registered depth and frame-event status outputs.
